text:
sara: Heads-up: CI alert showed a Vault transit unwrap using our KMS-wrapped key from a runner labeled `partner-restore`. Looks like a stale backup was restored during a retry. Need containment + rotation.

alex: paste the CI log line? which key id?

sara: log: 
```
2025-10-02T03:12:11Z ci-runner[partner-restore] INFO transit/unwrap: ciphertext=hQ2...xyz ksm_key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/partnerA-wrap principal=serviceAccount:ci-runner-partner@partners.gserviceaccount.com
```

mira: if the wrapper key was used by Vault transit, we must determine whether the runner had direct KMS decrypt perms or used Vaults proxy capability.

olivia: ops-bot pls fetch KMS IAM and recent DATA_ACCESS logs for that key (72h).

ops-bot: queued: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partnerA-wrap --keyring=ingest --location=global` and `gcloud logging read \"resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.serviceName:cloudkms.googleapis.com AND protoPayload.methodName:google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" --freshness=72h`  will post results.

sara: initial inventory: two CI runners for partner restore have SA membership in project-partnerA. They used to have a broad role.

alex: propose immediate steps: 1) suspend partner CI runners (or set to read-only), 2) rotate wrapper key (new key version + rewrap Vault keys), 3) tighten IAM.

mira: agree. Also enable a log-based alert that fires on KMS DECRYPTs from any CI runner SAs. We should sink that to sec-audit-bucket.

ops-bot: IAM dump complete. Binding shows `serviceAccount:ci-runner-partner@partners.gserviceaccount.com` had `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the key (granted at key level). Access log shows decrypts at 2025-10-02T03:12 and 03:15. Links: gs://redwood-ops-dumps/1755559999/kms-iam.txt and gs://redwood-ops-dumps/1755559999/kms-access.log

olivia: I'll flip the runners to paused and add a temporary deny rule on decrypt for that SA via org policy (audit-only then enforce).

sara: starting a Vault transit canary rewrap for `transit/keys/partnerA` now (dry-run first). Command used: 
```bash
vault write -field=ok transit/rewrap key=partnerA --dry-run=true
```

alex: nice. Also run a quick grep scan for leaked plaintext snapshots in recent artifact storage (last 30d).

mira: I'm drafting a terraform PR to convert the SA binding to a conditional custom role scoped by name prefix (partnerA-only) and to add `audit_configs.dataAccess: true` on the key resource. Will include a rollback target.

olivia: ops change: paused runners at 1755560060. Confirmed no new unwraps after pause (monitoring 12m).

ops-bot: rewrap dry-run reported 8 candidate ciphertexts, 0 rewrap failures. Log: gs://redwood-ops-dumps/1755559999/vault-rewrap-dryrun.log

sara: schedule: - immediate: pause runners + revoke SA decrypt role - canary: rewrap transit key for partnerA (dry-run -> live) in 30m - full: rewrap vault objects and re-encrypt backups during 02:00 maintenance window (coord with partner ops)

alex: owners: rewrap= sara, IAM pr = mira, runner ops = olivia, monitoring = alex. Escalation to oncall if access seen after revoke = ops-sre.

mira: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4890 includes conditional role and log sink change. Tagging @infra-team for fast-track review.

olivia: applying immediate revoke at 1755560200: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding partnerA-wrap --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner-partner@partners.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`

ops-bot: revoke executed. Wait 2m for propagation.

sara: canary rewrap live now for `transit/keys/partnerA` (no dry-run). Command: `vault write transit/rewrap key=partnerA`

alex: after rewrap, verify Vault decrypts with new wrapper key via the proxy account. Test vector: run small decrypt with `ci-test-principal` and ensure error.

mira: added terraform plan output and a mechanism to label the rotation rollout with `sec:ci-rot-2025`. PR includes an alert rule: Stackdriver logs-based alert for protoPayload.methodName=Decrypt + resource.labels.service_account=*ci-runner* -> notify #eng-security.

ops-bot: canary rewrap finished: 8 rewrapped, 0 errors. Rewrap log: gs://redwood-ops-dumps/1755559999/vault-rewrap.log

olivia: runners still paused. No decrypt log entries since revoke (monitored for 18m).

sara: moving to full rewrap during maintenance window at 02:00 UTC. Coordinating partner ops for read-only period.

alex: follow-ups: - rotate KMS key (new key version, destroy previous versions after 7d) - scan artifacts for any rehydrated plaintexts and notify customers if any found - add ephemeral token flow for partner restores (15m TTL) - add runbook step: immediate revoke + canary rewrap for any transit unwrap anomalies

mira: filing compliance ticket for audit: SEC-4810, attaching terraform diff and audit logs. Also will request a third-party attestation if any customer data was exposed.

olivia: scheduling a post-incident review. I'll collect timelines, PagerDuty notes, and add to the incident doc in SEC-4810.

ops-bot: monitoring hook created: logs-based alert -> #eng-security at 1755560500.

sara: final quick note: prefer Vault proxy for decrypts (service account with least privilege and context checks) vs granting partner SAs direct KMS decrypt. Roadmap item: implement proxy + ephemeral tokens.

alex: agreed. Also propose a monthly scan for repo/CI artifacts that contain `transit/unwrap` or `unwrapped_ciphertext` patterns.

mira: approving PR once infra-team gives the thumbs up. Will run `terraform apply` in canary mode with `--target` for the specific key resource first.

olivia: end-of-thread status: runners paused, SA revoke applied, canary rewrap success, full rewrap scheduled. Will update SEC-4810 with final results. :lock:
